searched: Searched (October 2026) web search plus direct retrieval of deepmind.google (About page, 2018 COO post, 2023 Google DeepMind announcement), blog.google (Pichai notes of April 2024, October 2024 and August 2026; Gemini 3 and Gemini 4 Argon safety posts; author pages for Kavukcuoglu, Hassabis, Dean), research.google profiles, arXiv (Attention Is All You Need v1 and v5; Codex v1; GSM8K v1, which did not list Kaiser), X posts via syndication (Suleyman 2019, Hassabis on Windsurf 2025, Shazeer 2026), Greylock, Discovery Loop's site and Radical Ventures' copy of Jeff Dean's thread, Essential AI (site and its December 2023 release via HPCwire), Inceptive, NEAR, Sakana, Cohere, Adept, Character.AI and Windsurf. Retrieval failures: Character.AI's August 2024 post (404, not in its sitemap); CNBC (relay 401; a syndicated NBC copy was read but not cited); Business Wire original of the Essential AI release (relay 422); near.org/about (401); USI profile of Shane Legg (401); blog.google author pages for Dragan, Ibrahim, Vinyals and Shazeer (404); research.google profile of Jeff Dean (404). Not found in a primary source and left out: Google Brain founders other than Ng (Dean, Corrado; Corrado's profile is used only for its own wording); the June 2025 announcement of Kavukcuoglu as Chief AI Architect (reporting only; the role is recorded from a dated byline); Shane Legg's Chief AGI Scientist title; Shazeer's 2024 appointment as Gemini co-lead (reported memo); Vinyals's Google titles; Ibrahim's appointment date as Chief AI Readiness Officer. Google DeepMind's About page retrieved 2026-10-15 still calls Hassabis 'Co-founder and CEO' after the August 2026 announcement; it is not used for his current role. Character.AI and Windsurf deal records, Adept co-founders, Gomez/Cohere and Jones/Sakana are in the deals and newlabs drafts and are not duplicated; this draft adds only the Google side and reuses their entity IDs and the TechCrunch source record.

claims.subject: jeff-dean
claims.statement: Sundar Pichai announced on 5 August 2026 that, after a 27-year run, Jeff Dean and Google Senior Fellow Sanjay Ghemawat were launching an independent public benefit corporation.

time.note: Announcement date; not a last working day.

attributes.role: Not named in the note (it refers to his 27-year run)

claims.inferenceRationale: Premises: (1) Pichai’s note of 5 August 2026 on Google’s AI leadership introduces its last change with “after an incredible 27-year run, Jeff Dean”; the note does not say where the run was; (2) it states that Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat are launching an independent public benefit corporation. Reasoning: read in a note about Google’s leadership, the 27-year run is taken as Dean’s tenure at Google, and the note as announcing his move from Google to the new company; it does not use the word “leave” or give a last day.
claims.qualification: The note does not name the role Dean left, his last day or whether any Google affiliation continues; the existing records give his 2023 Chief Scientist roles. A motive given in the note on his behalf is not recorded.

evidence.passage: Pichai’s note introduces the change by referring to Dean’s 27-year run, without naming Google in that sentence.
Jeff and Google Senior Fellow Sanjay Ghemawat are launching an independent public benefit corporation
